title: How a Man of God Honors His Parents After He's Moved Out
caption:
Moving out doesn't end the fifth commandment. It just means you're the one who has to go first now.

Call when you don't need anything. Apologize for the old stuff before they ask. Disagree with respect, and never mock them to your friends. Show up with your hands, not just your presence.

Send this to a brother who hasn't called home in a while.

#faith #godlyman #family #honor #christianmen
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
